title: Shushi and More...
description: This project adds quite a lot of food items and Allium Armour.
body:
# Installation
  1. Download the mod
  2. Download the NeoForge Mod Loader
  3. Go to Installations Tab of the Minecraft Launcher
  4. Make a new Installation For NeoForge
  5. Press the File Icon
  6. Make a "mods" folder
  7. Put the .jar file in the "mods" folder
  8. Then launch Minecraft
    
Or just download the Modrinth App
# Additions
This mod introduces...
- Allium Armour
- Kinds of Shushi
- Rice
- Allium Leather
- Peanut Butter and Strawberry Jam
- And More to Come
# Recipes

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Put Wheat in a Stonecutter to get rice

Surround a Rice with Kelp in a Crafting Table to get Shushi

Put Shushi with Steak or Tropical Fish to get a kind of Shushi

Put a Sweetberry in a Crafting Table to get a Strawberry

Put 4 Bowls in a square pattern to make a Peanut Shell

Brew a Peanut Shell into Rice to get Peanut Butter Filling

Brew a Strawberry into Rice to get Strawberry Filling

And There's more for you to discover!
</details>
